notes.title: Update Notes for August 2021
notes.content:
+ Increase in screen size (1600x960) to match the coming sequel game (The Thorns of War)

+ New GUI by MakeFox

+ Improved coding

+ All minor NPCs now have sprites

+ Some new backgrounds in the same style as The Thorns of War

notes.title: The Rose of Segunda - Sequel Kickstarter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32758062/a1c003ac7c46c31f43312062c72e1b0ca52e3d49.jpg[/img]

A sequel to The Rose of Segunda titled 'The Thorns of War' is currently on Kickstarter.

If you enjoyed your time with the characters of The Rose of Segunda and would like to see where the story takes them next, please feel free to check out the Kickstarter campaign here:
 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ttow/the-thorns-of-war
